items.title: X post from @oscarsspiastree: Q: Please update us on your life! "[it's] good. Busy. I mean especially this time of year. Its…
items.title_zh: X 发帖 @oscarsspiastree：问：请更新一下你的生活近况！“挺好的。很忙。我是说尤其是每年这个时候。所有那些远途分站总是非常非常忙。所以目前 F1 之外的生活没多少……我几个月前搬了公寓，现在还在往里搬。还在买新家具，花掉一些我的薪水。所以嗯，是的！这大概就是我目前生活里的全部了。我知道，真是精彩绝伦！”
items.summary: Q: Please update us on your life! "[it's] good. Busy. I mean especially this time of year. Its always very very busy with all the fly away races. So there's not much life going on outside of F1 at the moment...I did move apartment a few months ago which I'm still moving in to. And getting new furniture for and spending some of my salary on. So um yeah! that's pretty much all I got going on in my life at the moment. it's riveting stuff , I know!"
items.summary_zh: 问：请更新一下你的生活近况！“挺好的。很忙。我是说尤其是每年这个时候。所有那些远途分站总是非常非常忙。所以目前 F1 之外的生活没多少……我几个月前搬了公寓，现在还在往里搬。还在买新家具，花掉一些我的薪水。所以嗯，是的！这大概就是我目前生活里的全部了。我知道，真是精彩绝伦！”

items.title_zh: X 发帖 @oscarsspiastree：“也许我会去当和尚”——Oscar Piastri，2026。问：我不知道你有没有想过退役后要做什么，但我能想象你经营一家正念中心。“😂😂 也许吧，是的！我觉得目前我还需要正念中心来教我正念。不过，也许吧。谁知道呢！那肯定会是人生的大转折，这一点可以肯定。我不知道，也许吧！也许我退役后会去当和尚……😅”
items.summary: "Maybe I'll become a monk" - oscar piastri, 2026. Q: I don't know if you've given any thought to what you'd do after your retire but I could see you running a mindfulness centre. "😂😂. Maybe, yeah! I feel like I still need the mindfulness hub to teach me the mindfulness for now. But, maybe. You never know! It would be one hell of a life turn, that's for sure. I don't know, maybe! Maybe I'll become a monk after I retire...😅"
